findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router audit indicates call_log_exists is false and log_file path does not exist on disk

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router initializes its call log directory and file or configure proper log output paths.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and auditability into model router invocations, latency, and failure metrics.

findings.title: Quality anomaly forecasting missing database integration

evidence.observation: Hardcoded empty list with TODO comment: 'recent_anomalies = [] # TODO: Query quality_anomalies table'
